description: Installation of a 20m monopole, 12 no. antenna apertures, equipment cabinets, the removal of the existing 11.7m monopole, 3 no. antennas, redundant equipment cabinets and development ancillary thereto.
site_name: Land On The East Side Of
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Existing Site Plan; Proposed Site Plan; Proposed Elevation; Site Location Plan. Received: 04/10/2019.
Unnumbered Tree Report dated 20/11/2019. Received: 21/11/2019. ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Within 28 calendar days of the date of the apparatus hereby approved coming into use, the date of which shall be notified in writing to the Local Planning Authority no less than 14 calendar days prior, the existing apparatus shall be dismantled and removed from the site, including all associated debris.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the commencement of development, full details of replacement trees, including species; quantity and proposed location shall be agreed with the London Borough of Hounslow and/or Hounslow Highways, and these agreed details shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall thereafter be implemented in accordance with the approved details and the agreed species and quantity of replacement trees shall be planted in the agreed locations in the first planting season following the commencement of operation of the hereby approved telecommunications mast.
